Create a constellation plot.

Source: R/constellationPlot.R
constellationPlot.Rd

constellationPlot() turns a cloud of points into a star map by drawing glowing stars and connecting nearby points into short constellation-like segments.

constellationPlot(
  data,
  x,
  y,
  label = NULL,
  group = NULL,
  size = NULL,
  starRadius = 4,
  haloRadius = 12,
  maxLinks = 2,
  linkThreshold = 0.3,
  linkColor = "#8ECAE6",
  linkOpacity = 0.35,
  starFill = "#E0FBFC",
  palette = c("#E0FBFC", "#98C1D9", "#EE6C4D", "#FFB703", "#90E0EF"),
  showLegend = TRUE,
  legendTitle = NULL,
  showLabels = TRUE,
  labelColor = "#F8FAFC",
  labelFontSize = 12,
  title = NULL,
  titleFontSize = 22,
  font = "Verdana, Geneva, Tahoma, sans-serif",
  bgcol = "#020817",
  width = NULL,
  height = NULL
)

Arguments

data

The data frame containing the coordinates to plot.

x

The numeric column mapped to the horizontal position.

y

The numeric column mapped to the vertical position.

label

Optional. A column used to display star labels.

group

Optional. A categorical column used to color the stars.

size

Optional. A numeric column used to size the stars.

starRadius

Default star radius when size is not supplied. Defaults to 4.

haloRadius

Radius of the outer star glow. Defaults to 12.

maxLinks

Maximum number of short links created per star. Defaults to 2.

linkThreshold

Quantile used to keep only local links. Must be between 0 and 1. Defaults to 0.3.

linkColor

The color of the constellation links. Defaults to '#8ECAE6'.

linkOpacity

Opacity of the constellation links. Defaults to 0.35.

starFill

Default color used when group is not supplied. Defaults to '#E0FBFC'.

palette

Colors used when group is supplied.

showLegend

Logical. Whether to render a color legend when group is supplied. Defaults to TRUE.

legendTitle

Optional legend title. Defaults to the group column name.

showLabels

Logical. Whether to render labels. Defaults to TRUE.

labelColor

Color of the labels. Defaults to '#F8FAFC'.

labelFontSize

Font size of the labels. Defaults to 12.

title

Optional. Plot title.

titleFontSize

Font size of the title. Defaults to 22.

font

The font family used for text. Defaults to 'Verdana, Geneva, Tahoma, sans-serif'.

bgcol

Background color of the SVG. Defaults to '#020817'.

width

Optional. The width of the SVG output.

height

Optional. The height of the SVG output.

Value

A SVG constellation plot.

Examples

constellation_data <- data.frame(
  x = c(0.10, 0.22, 0.35, 0.52, 0.64, 0.78, 0.83),
  y = c(0.72, 0.58, 0.80, 0.50, 0.68, 0.42, 0.77),
  star = c("Atlas", "Lyra", "Vega", "Orion", "Nova", "Astra", "Solis"),
  cluster = c("North", "North", "North", "South", "South", "South", "North"),
  weight = c(4, 5, 3, 6, 4, 5, 3)
)

constellationPlot(
  data = constellation_data,
  x = "x",
  y = "y",
  label = "star",
  group = "cluster",
  size = "weight",
  title = "Similarity Constellation"
)
